title: Event Replay: Inside OpenAI: How OpenAI Teams use Codex to Do More
highlights: OpenAI Chief Economist Ronnie Chatterji and researcher Drew Johnston shared findings on how Codex adoption is changing workflows, enabling people to delegate longer tasks, run multiple workstreams in parallel, and expand beyond traditional job boundaries.

OpenAI teams demonstrated how agents support real-world work across data science, product design, and sales — automating KPI reports, building interactive prototypes, and managing recurring go-to-market processes.
Upcoming events teased: one on AI and scientific advances, another on how AI is helping doctors diagnose rare pediatric diseases.

title: How business operations teams use Codex: Webinar resource guide — OpenAI Academy
highlights: Learn how Codex helps business ops teams pull together context, check it against data, and create the first version of deliverables: cleaned initiative summaries, weekly bookings dashboards, team updates, leadership decision decks, and repeatable workflows.
Covers integration with Databricks, Slack, documents, spreadsheets, and local project files.
Practical starting point: pick one recurring workflow (a weekly performance readout or leadership deck) and let Codex automate it iteratively.

title: How sales teams use Codex: Webinar resource guide — OpenAI Academy
highlights: See how Codex helps sales teams build a prioritized account list, prospecting plan, draft outreach, meeting prep briefs, and a customer-ready proposal.
Demo shows Codex generating onsite AI workshop proposals — highly relevant for teams exploring AI adoption conversations with customers.
Integrates with CRM, Gmail, Google Calendar, and spreadsheets.

title: How data science teams use Codex (ChatGPT Work) — OpenAI Academy On-Demand Webinar
highlights: On-demand webinar covering top Codex use cases for data science teams — available to watch anytime.
Now runs in ChatGPT Work at chatgpt.com or in the ChatGPT desktop app (previously the standalone Codex app).
Companion recording: How finance teams use Codex — also available on-demand via OpenAI Academy.

title: OpenAI Forum: Upcoming Events on AI in Science & Rare Pediatric Disease Diagnosis (July 2026)
highlights: OpenAI announced two upcoming July 2026 Forum events: one focused on AI and scientific advances, and another on how AI is helping doctors diagnose rare pediatric diseases.
These events will be hosted live on the OpenAI Forum — follow the forum to be notified when registration opens.
Both events continue the series that has explored how agents can tackle complex, domain-specific tasks across research and healthcare.
